start_here: Say to your AI: "Read my Stripe account" and give the vault entry name of the Stripe key. It runs tool:read-my-stripe-account with that key_name.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it reads the Stripe account and writes nothing.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Read my Stripe account" with the vault entry name. It calls tools:run with tool tool:read-my-stripe-account and {key_name}.
2. Read company name, address state and country, business type and profile name.
3. The key is never shown. The read changes nothing.

worked_examples.title: Read the Stripe account's business profile
worked_examples.given: Reads tools/stripe-account/tool-rows.json: a GET to https://api.stripe.com/v1/account with the vault entry named by key_name as a bearer header, bound to api.stripe.com. Reads only.

input.key_name: <the vault entry name for the Stripe key>

worked_examples.hands_back: It answers the four fields only, for example {"company_name": "<the company name Stripe holds>", "address_state": "<state>", "address_country": "US", "business_type": "company", "profile_name": "<the profile name>"}. The values are read from Stripe on each call; this example is the shape, not a result. The key is never shown.
